title: Wiki — 山谷飛行（第一幕）
frame_numbering: 1-based per scene. File 0001 = Blender frame 1, file 0300 = Blender frame 300. progress p (0..1) -> file 1 + round(p * 299).

continuity.next: file 0300 matches file 0001 of the next scene

deterministic: Camera keyed on every frame (linear). Water, waterfall and mist textures are static (no frame drivers); live motion is the frontend layer. The only frame-driven values are the cloud-sea fade-in (frames 300-345) and the cave fog switch when the camera enters the cave. Any frame renders identically in any order.

mobile.camera: FlightCamPortrait (shares FlightCam's animation; 28 mm, vertical sensor fit; rendered separately, not cropped)
mobile.encoder: ffmpeg libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -g 8 -keyint_min 8 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 0 -an, from lossless PNG

desktop.channels: R = lake / river surface visible, G = waterfall curtain visible (rock, trees, bridge in front are black). Mist and clouds ignored.

mobile.channels: R = lake / river surface visible, G = waterfall curtain visible (rock, trees, bridge in front are black). Mist and clouds ignored.

camera.path: camera_path.json (every frame: location + XYZ euler, metres, Z up)
camera.analysis: camera_analysis.json (pitch/yaw + screen positions of waterfall, bridge, cave mouth and lanterns, desktop and mobile, with occlusion)

slow_windows.note: file-number ranges where the camera moves at under 45% of this scene's median speed: steadiest places for text
